effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Main] Place this card as 1 of your non-white Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted by battle, by placing 1 [Recharge Plug-In Q] from this Digimon's digivolution cards at the bottom of your security stack, prevent that deletion.
